'''Warrenpoint Town Football Club''', referred to as '''Warrenpoint Town''', or "'''The Point'''", is a semi-professional Northern Irish football club that plays in the [[NIFL Championship]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/65690578|title=Warrenpoint Town:Club set to be relegated to expanded PIL|publisher=BBC Sport NI|access-date=25 May 2023|archive-date=25 May 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230525092951/https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/65690578|url-status=live}}</ref> Warrenpoint Town are a part of the [[Mid-Ulster Football Association]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Mid Ulster Football Association |url=https://midulsterfa.co.uk/ |access-date=2025-12-03 |website=midulsterfa.co.uk}}</ref> The club competes in the [[Irish Cup]]."}}
